mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong economy with tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a short-term equity market correction as the central bank combats inflationary pressures, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (defined by UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong consumer demand and stable corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and residential investment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity and related spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1700 thousand units combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the demand for housing and manufactured goods, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1700 and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown in both consumer demand and manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face pressure from reduced sales and production.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of industrial production slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% year-over-year), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as manufacturing weakness signals reduced corporate investment and potential earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% year-over-year, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
